items.claim: Gregory Rodriguez is difficult to take down.
items.quote: Not many guys can take Robocop down

items.claim: Gregory Rodriguez possesses significant knockout power.
items.quote: Gregory Rodriguez hits hard. Pereira knockout win. Hermansson knockout win.

items.claim: Anthony Hernandez exhausts opponents with his relentless wrestling and ground and pound.
items.quote: once Hernandez takes you down, he makes your life hell. He's going to take you down and he's going to come, you know, consistently punch and throw and ground and pound over and over and over again and he's again he will tire you out.

items.claim: Gregory Rodriguez has never been submitted in his career.
Anthony Hernandez struggled to deal with adversity in the Sean Strickland fight.
items.quote: something that he didn't do particularly well the Strickland fight

items.claim: Anthony Hernandez actively looks to finish opponents on the ground rather than just holding position.
items.quote: Hernandez is not a guy who's going to lay in pray lay in pray with you on the ground. He's going to take you down and he's looking to actively finish.
